description: Build berylx-py wheel from clean commit and verify isolated install, public API imports, and sequential/parallel workflow execution
smoke: "$CC_INSPECT_SMOKE_DIR/venv/bin/python" -I -c 'import asyncio, os, zipfile; from pathlib import Path; import berylx; from berylx import AsyncTask, BerylxTimeline, EffectTree, Graph, Ok, Root, Task, Timeline, VERSION, Workflow, berylx as make_berylx, darkcore; build_dir = Path(os.environ["CC_INSPECT_BUILD_DIR"]).resolve(); artifact_dir = Path(os.environ["CC_INSPECT_ARTIFACT_DIR"]).resolve(); smoke_dir = Path(os.environ["CC_INSPECT_SMOKE_DIR"]).resolve(); venv_dir = (smoke_dir / "venv").resolve(); assert not (smoke_dir / "pyproject.toml").exists() and not (smoke_dir / ".cc-inspect.json").exists(); wheels = sorted(artifact_dir.glob("*.whl")); assert len(wheels) == 1, wheels; zf = zipfile.ZipFile(wheels[0]); names = zf.namelist(); zf.close(); assert "berylx/__init__.py" in names; assert not any(".cc-inspect.json" in name for name in names), names; pkg_file = Path(berylx.__file__).resolve(); assert build_dir not in pkg_file.parents, pkg_file; assert venv_dir in pkg_file.parents, pkg_file; assert venv_dir in Path(darkcore.__file__).resolve().parents; assert isinstance(VERSION, str) and len(VERSION) > 0 and berylx.__version__ == VERSION; b = make_berylx(); trim = b.task("trim", lambda f: f.at("user").at("name").update(str.strip)); charge = Task.of("charge", lambda f: f.at("total").set(100)); root = Root.of({"user": {"name": "  mina  "}, "total": 0}); seq_res = root.call(trim.then(charge)); assert isinstance(seq_res, Ok) and seq_res.is_ok(); assert root.at("user").at("name").get() == "mina" and root.state()["total"] == 100; left = Task.of("left", lambda f: f.put("a", 1)); right = Task.of("right", lambda f: f.put("b", 2)); combine = Task.of("combine", lambda f: f.put("sum", f.at("a").get() + f.at("b").get())); wf = Workflow.of("smoke_wf", lambda: left.par(right).then(combine)); par_res = wf.call({"a": 0, "b": 0}); assert isinstance(par_res, Ok) and par_res.is_ok(); assert dict(par_res.focus.to_object()) == {"a": 1, "b": 2, "sum": 3}; assert Graph.from_node(wf).nodes() == ["left", "right", "combine"]; fetch = Task.of("fetch", lambda f, p: f.put("answer", p.perform("lookup", 7))); eff_res = EffectTree.run(fetch, {}, EffectTree.real_handlers({"lookup": lambda k: k * 6})); assert isinstance(eff_res, Ok) and eff_res.focus.at("answer").get() == 42; async_wf = AsyncTask.of("ax", lambda f: asyncio.sleep(0, result=f.put("x", f.at("x").get() + 10))).par(AsyncTask.of("ay", lambda f: asyncio.sleep(0, result=f.put("y", f.at("y").get() + 20))), workers=2); async_res = asyncio.run(EffectTree.run_async(async_wf, {"x": 1, "y": 2})); assert isinstance(async_res, Ok) and dict(async_res.focus.to_object()) == {"x": 11, "y": 22}; assert darkcore.run(darkcore.op("id", 41, int).bind(lambda n: darkcore.pure(n + 1)), {"id": lambda x: x}) == 42; assert callable(Timeline) and callable(BerylxTimeline); print("BERYLX_PY_SMOKE_OK", VERSION, pkg_file)'
